newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch company results week Sept 9-13.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch company results week Sept 9-13.

text.p: Analysts' estimates of Dutch company earnings to be reported in the week beginning Sept 9.
Earnings figures refer to net profit before extraordinary items in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated.
* Vendex profit is before "changes in value".
Estimates contributed by: Bangert Pontier, BZW, Generale Bank, ING Barings, Kempen & Co, Bank Labouchere, Van Lanschot, MeesPierson and NIB Strating.
Banks and brokers interested in contributing to this regular Reuters survey can contact the Amsterdam newsroom on +31-20-504-5000 or fax their forecasts to +31-20-504 5040.
For the week of September 16-20 we are looking for expectations for Computer Management Group (CMG).
